description: Surgical edits turning the pristine Theater 1.10.0 video.chunk.js into the VIDAA build. Re-anchored from the 1.9.2 baseline (8775223 + fork mods) onto the 1.10.0 minified output. 1.10.0 absorbed the old dead 1477.chunk.js player engine into this chunk.

ops.note: Engine 'load' event: skip re-initializing when the stream URL did not change (fork mod from 1.9.2 — the vanilla dead check (C=t.stream)!==t.stream never fired, so repeated loads re-buffered).
forceTranscoding now also honors the window.__FORCE_TRANSCODE__ flag set by the Blue remote key / patch layer.
Propagates the forced-transcode decision into the server URL params (reads _vft declared by the previous op; this site is a .then closure inside the same function).

Server /tracks/ listing (module 2152): use the app-configured server URL (kernel/server-url.js) instead of hardcoded 127.0.0.1, with a 10s abort timeout (fork mod from 1.9.2 module 4775 — vanilla hangs forever when no local service exists).

HTML5 engine canPlayStream: probe even when behaviorHints.notWebReady is set (fork mod from 1.9.2 — with a streaming server those streams are playable via transcode, so refusing to probe breaks server-assisted playback).
